about_the_game:
Choose your battles. Earn your power. Conquer the arena.

Step into a beautifully illustrated fantasy world where every choice leads to bloodshed—or glory. In this short-form medieval RPG, you’ll select your arena, choose your opponent, and enter combat with mystical foes.

Defeat enemies to earn gold and silver, which you can spend on weapons and armor to enhance your attack and defense stats. Face off against increasingly dangerous foes for greater rewards and hidden treasures. Strategically plan your route through the arenas, manage your resources wisely, and challenge the most fearsome enemies in the realm.

With a complete game experience designed to be beaten in about 30 minutes, this is a perfect bite-sized RPG for players who love progression, strategy, and fantasy action.

Key Features

  • ⚔️ Arena-Based Combat: Pick your next fight and face off against fantastical foes.

  • 💰 Resource Management: Earn gold and silver to upgrade gear and improve your odds.

  • 🛡️ Equipment Progression: Buy and equip better weapons and armor to enhance your stats.

  • 🐉 Boss Encounters: Unlock powerful enemies and defeat them to earn rare rewards.

  • 🎨 Unique Art Style: Immerse yourself in a fantasy world inspired by medieval aesthetics.

  • ⏱️ Quick Yet Complete: Full game experience that can be completed in 30 minutes, perfect for short sessions.

Will you rise through the ranks and conquer the coliseum—or fall to the might of dragons?
